caption: The drawing consists of a detailed depiction of an iron trivet with an ornate, openwork design featuring curved and interlacing scroll patterns. The trivet is triangular in shape with a pointed end and a circular handle at the opposite end. The composition is rendered in grayscale, showing shading and highlights to indicate the metallic material of the object. The main image displays the trivet in perspective, while a smaller, orthographic projection above it shows the trivet from the top and side views, with a scale for size reference located beneath. The trivet stands on three short legs, as indicated in both the perspective and side view. The drawing is contained within a fine rectangular border, and the name "HOLGER HANSEN" appears printed in the lower left corner. There are minor splatters and a stain of brown discoloration in the upper left corner of the otherwise cream-colored background.
title: Flat Iron Holder
